name: MITSUI E&S Co., Ltd.
summary: MITSUI E&S Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides marine propulsion systems in Japan, Asia, Europe, North America, and internationally. The company offers reciprocating compressor, high-pressure hydrogen compressor, gas turbines, axial flow compressor, top pressure recovery turbine, pressure vessels, steam tube dryer, and hydraulic model testing equipment; marine engine, engine peripheral systems, DX system, and after-sales services; cargo handling equipment; digital transformation services comprising container terminal management system, smart port digital solutions, and crane advance remote monitoring systems; and engineering projects and IT solutions.
